specific_objectives: 23.1.5.1 Trainee will be able to explain the construction and functioning of aircraft flight controls systems and its components.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Identification of control system components on aircraft model; Safety: Handle model parts gently; Supervision: Instructor monitors identification accuracy
intro_questions: What are the primary flight controls of an aircraft?
How does a pilot initiate a turn using the control yoke?
Name the secondary flight controls found on modern aircraft.

development.content:
Primary flight control surfaces
Control system linkage mechanisms
Hydraulic actuation systems
Electrical control components

Functioning of ailerons and elevators
Rudder operation and yaw control
Flap and spoiler mechanisms
Trim system operation

Fail-safe mechanisms in controls
Redundancy in flight control systems
Maintenance checks for control links
Troubleshooting common control issues

summary_questions: Explain how hydraulic pressure assists in moving control surfaces.
Describe the role of trim tabs in reducing pilot workload.
Identify two fail-safe features in a typical flight control system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the need for simple oxygen systems and the effects of lack of oxygen, as covered in LP 23.

pft_rows.syllabus: Need for simple oxygen system and pressurized cabin effect of lack of o2, Types of 02 regulators. Fire detection and protection system:
